en.title: How should an expansion signal be verified?
en.intro: Scenario: A manufacturer wants to understand whether a competitor is entering a new regional market.
items: Public job listings include new regional sales roles.
Public procurement notices indicate additional equipment needs.
One signal does not prove that capacity is operational or market entry is complete.
en.analysis: The signals may indicate expansion preparations, staff replacement or an upgrade to an existing production line. More sources are needed to assess them.
en.next: Verify listing dates and locations; investigate equipment use and project milestones; compare new evidence in the next brief.

en.title: What should you ask before entering a market?
en.intro: Scenario: An industrial equipment company is evaluating a new application area and wants to prioritize its research.
items: Procurement processes and entry requirements for the target application.
Products, channels and service models of leading competitors.
Verifiable demand evidence and information that is still missing.
en.analysis: Organize evidence around customer needs, entry barriers, competitive differentiation and execution capability. Assess opportunity beyond market size alone.
en.next: Identify priority customer types; plan demand interviews; compare entry routes and assumptions to validate.

en.title: Could a new technology change the competition?
en.intro: Scenario: A manufacturing team is following an alternative technology and wants to distinguish technical progress from commercialization.
items: Technical developments in papers, patents and product announcements.
Application progress reflected in certifications, pilots and procurement.
Commercial conditions revealed by production, maintenance and cost data.
en.analysis: Assess technical and commercial feasibility separately. Keep conclusions qualified when application and cost evidence is lacking.
en.next: Compare technology pathways; identify key validation milestones; update the watchlist as evidence emerges.

zh.title: 一个扩张信号，值得怎样验证？
zh.intro: 场景：某制造企业希望理解竞争对手是否正在进入新的区域市场。
items: 公开招聘出现新的区域销售岗位。
公开采购信息出现新增设备需求。
单个线索不能证明产能已建成或市场进入已完成。
zh.analysis: 这些线索可能指向扩张准备，也可能是人员替换或既有产线升级。需要结合更多来源判断。
zh.next: 核验岗位发布时间与工作地点；追踪设备用途和项目节点；下一期简报对照新增证据。

zh.title: 进入一个市场，先回答哪些问题？
zh.intro: 场景：一家工业设备企业评估新应用领域，希望明确研究顺序。
items: 目标应用的采购流程与准入要求。
主要竞争者的产品、渠道及服务模式。
能够核验的需求证据，以及目前缺失的信息。
zh.analysis: 从客户问题、进入门槛、竞争差异和执行能力四个维度组织证据，避免仅凭市场规模判断机会。
zh.next: 明确优先客户类型；安排需求访谈；比较进入路径与待验证假设。

zh.title: 一条新技术路线，是否改变竞争？
zh.intro: 场景：一个制造团队关注替代技术，希望区分技术进展与商业化进展。
items: 论文、专利与产品发布中的技术变化。
认证、试点与采购信息中的应用进展。
量产、维护与成本数据中的商业化条件。
zh.analysis: 技术可行性与商业可行性需要分别判断。缺乏应用和成本证据时，应保留结论边界。
zh.next: 建立技术路线对照；列出关键验证节点；按节点更新观察清单。
